'''Annisa''' was a flavorful [[Plant/Legends|herb]] that grew in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] near [[the Tanglewoods]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. It was often steeped in [[Water/Legends|water]] to create a beverage with a subtle taste and aroma that was similar to [[Tea/Legends|tea]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Roan Lands]] and [[Dona Telamark]] walked the streets of Bellassa's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ussa]] while searching for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. Due to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], supplies were low, and they could find water flavored with annisa, but not tea.<ref name="Secret weapon">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Annisa was first mentioned in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'', a [[2007]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the seventh installment in the ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Secret weapon" />
